text: What's up, lad?
zh: 有什么事，小子？

text: Make it quick, I have a new batch of weapons to forge for the army.
zh: 有话快说，我还有一批新武器要给军队打呢。

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: You are forging weapons for the army?
zh: 你在为军队打造武器？

text: I am here to get a new weapon.
zh: 我是来弄件新武器的。

text: Do you sell your weapons?
zh: 你打的武器卖吗？

text: Do you live here alone?
zh: 你一个人住在这里吗？

text: I'll deliver your letter.
zh: 我来帮你送信吧。

text: Korg received your letter.
zh: 科尔格收到你的信了。

text: See you!
zh: 回头见！

text: I am #:Kolfinn:#, the best smith here in the capital.
zh: 我是#:科尔芬:#，王都这里最好的铁匠。

text: Usually, you'll find me around my forge working for the army.
zh: 平时你都能在我的锻炉边找到我，我在为军队干活。

text:
Yes, I've been forging weapons for the army for years now.
Ever since I opened my shop here in the capital.
zh:
是啊，我为军队打造武器已经好些年了。
自打我在王都开了这间铺子起就一直如此。

text: It is not paying well, but the army usually protect me and my shop.
zh: 报酬不算丰厚，但军队通常会保护我和我的铺子。

text: I also sell my spare wares to the weapon traders around here for some extra income.
zh: 我还会把多余的货卖给附近的武器商人，赚点外快。

text:
I myself am not allowed to.
Only the royal guard may buy one of my crafts directly.
zh:
我自己是不许直接卖的。
只有皇家卫队才能直接买我打造的东西。

text: Have a good day, lad!
zh: 祝你今天顺利，小子！

text: Go ask the traders around here if you're in need of a new weapon.
zh: 要是需要新武器，就去问问附近的商人吧。

text: It is a pitiful display, isn't it?
zh: 挺可怜的光景，是吧？

text: My family has unfortunately left me long ago.
zh: 不幸的是，我的家人早就离我而去了。

text: My wife passed away shortly after the birth of my son.
zh: 我妻子在儿子出生后不久就过世了。

text:
And my son, Korg, left the capital to be a bandit.
He was to inherit my forge here, but he obviously had other plans.
zh:
而我儿子科尔格离开王都当了强盗。
他本该继承我这间锻造铺，但他显然另有打算。

text: I met Korg at the bandit camp to the west.
zh: 我在西边的强盗营地见到了科尔格。

text: Where is your son now?
zh: 你儿子现在在哪儿？

text: So, my son is still alive?
zh: 这么说，我儿子还活着？

text:
I am glad to hear that.
However, I wish he'd visit me from time to time if that's so.
zh:
听到这个我很高兴。
不过，既然如此，真希望他能时不时回来看看我。

text:
I don't know.
He said, he wanted to join Goran's bandits.
zh:
我不知道。
他说过，他想加入戈兰的强盗团。

text:
Not even sure if he's still alive!
I truly hope so...
zh:
我甚至不确定他是否还活着！
我真心希望他还活着……

text: Could you do me a favor?
zh: 你能帮我个忙吗？

text: It's been a long time since we last spoke.
zh: 我们已经很久没说过话了。

text: I've written a letter for him a while ago, but I didn't know how I would get it to him.
zh: 前阵子我给他写了封信，却不知道该怎么送到他手上。

text: Could you deliver the letter for me?
zh: 你能替我把信送去吗？

text: Yes, give me the letter.
zh: 好，把信给我吧。

text: I don't have time for that.
zh: 我没时间做这个。

text:
Thank you!
You shall not regret this.
zh:
谢谢你！
你不会后悔的。

text: Ah, no issue. Was merely a hopeful thought anyhow.
zh: 啊，没关系。反正也只是我的一点念想罢了。

text: I'll be here, in case you change your mind.
zh: 我就在这儿，万一你改变主意了呢。

text: Here, take the letter and bring it to Korg.
zh: 来，拿上这封信，把它交给科尔格。

text: Did you give Korg my letter?
zh: 你把我的信交给科尔格了吗？

text: You're a newly joined guard, then?
zh: 这么说，你是新入队的卫兵？

text:
Here, take this spear.
This is the standard weapon of any royal guard.
zh:
来，拿上这杆长矛。
这是皇家卫队的制式武器。

text:
Great!
What did my son say?
zh:
太好了！
我儿子怎么说？

text: He needs to think about it. Give him some time.
zh: 他需要考虑一下。给他点时间吧。

text: I don't know what there is to think about it, but okay.
zh: 我不知道这有什么好考虑的，不过也罢。

text: Korg shall get his time to think.
zh: 就让科尔格慢慢考虑吧。

text:
There you are!
Korg and I had a lot to discuss.
zh:
你来啦！
我和科尔格聊了很多。

text:
He also showed me his new hammer. Truly impressive.
You weren't uninvolved in that, were you?
zh:
他还给我看了他的新锤子。着实令人赞叹。
这里头也有你的功劳，对吧？

text:
I hadn't expected him to bring flowers for my beloved Martja.
He also seemed to miss her.
zh:
我没想到他会为我挚爱的玛尔佳带来鲜花。
看得出他也很想念她。

text:
I hadn't thought he'd agree to visit me here.
Still, I was happy to see my boy again.
zh:
我原以为他不会答应来这儿看我。
不管怎样，能再见到我的孩子，我很高兴。

text:
Anyway.
You've been a great help to us, and I have to thank you for that!
zh:
总之。
你帮了我们大忙，我必须好好谢谢你！

text: This is for you.
zh: 这是给你的。

text:
This is a rare Ver'kum steel bar.
One of the finest materials there are.
zh:
这是一块稀有的维尔库姆钢锭。
世上最上乘的材料之一。
